summary: Retest of VANGUARD '44 v4 after race-bug fixes (atomic upsert + lock on new-save creation, /campaign/wipe in-place rewrite, GET /squad creates save first). Backend race regression tests + all previously-passing browser checks re-ran. One stale browser check (mobile-touch-tap-select-and-order) was fixed: its screen-position math assumed the canvas-center equals the centered ally's position, which breaks when centerOn clamps the camera near map edges; rewrote it to derive screen coords from window.__vanguard.view/cam per the briefing's exact recipe, and it now passes. Added one new browser check for the mobile-friendly-layout criterion which had no prior artifact. All 7 backend tests and all 9 browser checks pass.
action_items: mobile-touch-tap-select-and-order.mjs was previously using canvas-bounding-box-center as the tap target, which fails when centerOn() clamps the camera at a map edge (first mission mens' spawn point is near the west edge). Rewrote per the briefing's view/cam screen-coordinate formula; now deterministic and passing. No app bug -- test-script issue only, now fixed.

checks.criterion: Mobile tap-to-select and tap-to-order via PointerEvent (touch) on battle-canvas
checks.name: mobile-touch-tap-select-and-order
checks.evidence: FIXED script: computed screen pos via window.__vanguard.view{s,ox,oy} and .cam{x,y} after centerOn (left+view.ox+(x-cam.x)*view.s). Tap on ally -> window.__vanguard.selected.length === 1; tap 150 world px east -> debugAllies().find(name).orders > 0 (expect.poll resolved within 5s). No error overlay. Previous version (canvas-bbox-center assumption) failed with orders stuck at 0 because centerOn clamps camera near map edge; now deterministic.
